scripts.prepare:content: bun scripts/build-content.ts && bun scripts/build-equations.ts && bun scripts/extract-kernel-source.ts
scripts.prepare:lab: bun scripts/generate-lab.mjs && bun scripts/generate-tracers.mjs && bun scripts/generate-walks.mjs && bun scripts/generate-inference.mjs && bun scripts/generate-observation.mjs
scripts.dev: bun run prepare:content && bun run prepare:lab && next dev
scripts.build: bun run prepare:content && bun run prepare:lab && next build
scripts.typecheck: bun run prepare:content && bun run prepare:lab && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: bun run prepare:content && bun run prepare:lab && bun test --isolate --timeout 60000 src scripts
scripts.test:reference: bun run prepare:content && bun run prepare:lab && bun test --isolate --timeout 60000 src/testing/*.test.mjs
